linlee_lemon_tea_duck_toy.object_name: LINLEE Lemon Tea Little Yellow Duck Soft Toy
linlee_lemon_tea_duck_toy.description: A rounded, short, and chubby mini yellow duck soft toy with high-saturation matte lemon-yellow color, a smooth and non-reflective surface, two small pure-black round eyes, and a green logo printed below the belly. When grasping, prioritize the middle of the body and avoid the head or tail.

simulated_kiwi_toy.description: A toy that closely mimics the oval shape of a real kiwi, with a brownish-yellow base color, irregular rough texture across the surface, and patches of green. When grasping, prioritize the middle section and avoid the ends.

simulated_starfruit_toy.description: A toy that closely mimics the five-lobed starfruit form, with a soft translucent pale yellow color, matte rubber-like feel, and a few small brown speckles. When grasping, prioritize the central region and avoid the lobe edges.

simulated_cucumber_toy.description: A long cucumber-shaped toy with rounded ends, a slightly swollen middle, a deep green body, and small pale brown speckles on the surface. When grasping, align with the long axis and grip the middle section.

cube.description: A yellow cube that is soft, a bit rough on two faces and quite smooth on the other faces. When grasping, make sure that the gripper fingertips are clamped onto the side of the cube.
